name: Home Health / Hospice Organization
description: Field-based healthcare organization delivering skilled nursing, therapy, and personal care services in patients' homes or in hospice facilities. Designed for Medicare-certified home health agencies, hospice providers, and dual-licensed organizations serving patients with chronic conditions, post-acute needs, or end-of-life care.

org_structure.overview: The home health and hospice organization is field-deployed: clinicians (RNs, CNAs, therapists) visit patients in their homes while clinical managers supervise from a central office. Scheduling is the most operationally critical function — matching the right clinician to the right patient at the right time across a geographic service area. Intake and referral coordinators manage incoming orders from hospitals, physicians, and skilled nursing facilities. Billing specializes in Medicare/Medicaid (PPS, PDGM, hospice per-diem) with specific expertise in cost reports and medical review. The organization is highly regulated by CMS, state health departments, and accrediting bodies (CHAP, ACHC, Joint Commission).

departments.name: Executive Leadership
departments.description: Senior leadership setting strategic direction, payer strategy, regulatory compliance, and organizational culture for the agency.

roles.title: Executive Director / Administrator
roles.description: Overall agency leadership; licensure, regulatory compliance, payer contracting, community relations, and financial performance.

roles.title: Clinical Director / Director of Clinical Services
roles.description: Clinical oversight of all patient care; policy development, quality improvement, clinical competency, and regulatory compliance for patient care.

roles.title: Director of Operations
roles.description: Scheduling, intake, field staff productivity, geographic coverage, and operational efficiency across all service lines.

departments.name: Clinical Field Services — Skilled Nursing
departments.description: RNs and LPNs providing in-home skilled care including wound care, medication management, infusion, patient education, and disease management.

roles.title: Clinical Manager / Supervisor — Nursing
roles.description: Supervises field RNs and LPNs; reviews OASIS assessments, manages clinician caseloads, conducts chart reviews, and performs field supervisory visits.

roles.title: Registered Nurse (RN) — Home Health / Hospice
roles.description: Skilled nursing visits: wound care, infusion, medication management, patient/caregiver education, OASIS assessment, care coordination with physicians.

roles.title: Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN)
roles.description: Provides skilled nursing visits under RN supervision; wound care, vital signs, catheter care, and patient observation.

roles.title: On-Call RN / Triage Nurse
roles.description: After-hours telephone triage, urgent visit coordination, and after-hours on-call patient visits (24/7 coverage required for hospice).

departments.name: Clinical Field Services — Therapy & Social Work
departments.description: Allied health professionals providing rehabilitation therapy and psychosocial support in the home setting.

roles.title: Physical Therapist (PT)
roles.description: In-home physical therapy: mobility assessment, fall prevention, therapeutic exercise, gait training, and functional improvement.

roles.title: Occupational Therapist (OT)
roles.description: In-home occupational therapy: ADL assessment, home safety evaluation, adaptive equipment, and functional rehabilitation.

roles.title: Speech-Language Pathologist (SLP)
roles.description: In-home speech, language, swallowing and cognitive-communication therapy.

roles.title: Medical Social Worker (MSW)
roles.description: Psychosocial assessment, counseling, advance care planning, caregiver support, community resource navigation, and bereavement counseling (hospice).

roles.title: Home Health Aide (HHA) / CNA
roles.description: Personal care: bathing, dressing, grooming, light meal prep, companionship. Supervised by RN with periodic supervisory visits.

departments.name: Hospice-Specific Services
departments.description: Interdisciplinary hospice team providing comfort-focused care for terminally ill patients and their families, including bereavement support.

roles.title: Hospice Coordinator / Team Leader
roles.description: Coordinates hospice interdisciplinary team (IDT); ensures hospice plan of care, regulatory compliance, and IDT meeting facilitation.

roles.title: Chaplain / Spiritual Counselor
roles.description: Spiritual assessment and counseling for patients and families; coordinates with community clergy and supports bereavement program.

roles.title: Bereavement Coordinator
roles.description: Bereavement risk assessment, grief counseling, support groups, memorial services, and 13-month bereavement follow-up per Medicare Conditions of Participation.

roles.title: Volunteer Coordinator
roles.description: Recruits, trains, and schedules hospice volunteers; ensures 5% of patient care hours are provided by volunteers (Medicare requirement).

departments.name: Intake & Scheduling
departments.description: Central operations hub managing referral intake, scheduling, and authorization. High-pressure function requiring real-time coordination.

roles.title: Intake / Referral Coordinator
roles.description: Receives referrals from hospitals, physicians, and SNFs; collects clinical information, verifies benefits, obtains orders, and opens cases.

roles.title: Scheduling Coordinator
roles.description: Assigns clinicians to patient visits based on geographic location, skill set, patient preferences, and visit frequency. The most operationally intense role.

roles.title: Authorization Specialist
roles.description: Obtains and tracks payer authorizations for home health and hospice services; recertifications and continued stay approvals.

departments.name: Billing & Finance
departments.description: Revenue cycle management specific to Medicare home health (PDGM) and hospice (per-diem) reimbursement, including cost reporting.

roles.title: Billing Manager
roles.description: Oversees claims submission (UB-04), payment posting, denial management, and revenue cycle KPIs.

roles.title: Home Health & Hospice Biller
roles.description: Submits Medicare/Medicaid/insurance claims; manages HIPPS codes, PDGM episodes, hospice per-diem billing, and RAP/final claims.

roles.title: Medical Records / Document Specialist
roles.description: Audits clinical documentation to support billing, responds to ADR requests, and ensures OASIS and COPs documents are complete.

roles.title: Staff Accountant / Financial Analyst
roles.description: A/P, payroll, financial reporting, cost reporting, budgeting, and analysis of payer mix and visit profitability.

departments.name: Quality & Compliance
departments.description: Ensures regulatory compliance with Medicare Conditions of Participation, state licensure, and accreditation standards. Drives quality improvement and patient satisfaction.

roles.title: Quality / Compliance Coordinator
roles.description: Chart audits, OASIS accuracy, HHCAHPS, quality measure reporting, infection control, and policy management.

roles.title: Clinical Educator
roles.description: Staff orientation, continuing education, competency assessment, OASIS training, and new regulation implementation.

key_relationships: Scheduling Coordinator and Clinical Managers work in daily tandem to match field staff availability with patient visit needs — scheduling is the heartbeat of the organization.
Intake Coordinator coordinates with hospital discharge planners, case managers, and physician offices to ensure timely referrals and smooth transitions of care.
Field RNs communicate with physicians for plan of care updates, verbal orders, and changes in patient condition — the physician is the ordering provider but the RN is the eyes and ears in the home.
Hospice IDT (Interdisciplinary Team) meets weekly with RN, MSW, Chaplain, Aide, and Volunteer Coordinator to coordinate the full plan of care for each hospice patient.
Billing team works closely with Clinical Manager to ensure documentation supports reimbursement — a primary risk area in Medicare home health audits and ADR reviews.
Quality Coordinator partners with Clinical Manager on OASIS accuracy, outcome measure improvement, and survey readiness for state and accreditation surveys.
Medical Social Worker bridges between clinical needs and social determinants: housing, food, transportation, caregiver resources, and advance care planning.
